**{{NPC location|Unwaking Waters|explorable area}}

:''"Magnificent [[Kraken Spawn|kraken spawn]] haunt this area. Their eyes, once dried and hardened, make wonderful pieces of jewelry. Would you bring me some? Eyes, that is.
